definitions.target: sum floor(source interval width * selected duration Q11 / 2048), zero-target fallback to period
definitions.budget: sum previous carry + target - new carry; telescopes to target - final carry
definitions.emitted: sum periods actually written, before the 4800-frame terminal silence
definitions.unit_duration: portable duration request from D log; not captured PC feature records

caveats: Matching local clocks does not validate the target against PC phone coefficients
WORD delta saturation and rounded writes can make emitted differ slightly from step budget
This audit does not validate missing runtime rollback/source-selection behavior
